name: hud_ui_options_panel_lighting_sync_from_options
description: HudUiOptionsPanel_Lighting::SyncFromOptions toggles the lighting checkbox and writes the current hardware-mode graphics flags with the global-light bit set or cleared to match the new checked state.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred for the HUD options-panel source-file/table cluster. The current source restores behavior and table ownership; exact VC5SP3 byte comparison remains a later pass.
functional_evidence: Current Binary Ninja decompilation for 0x40c9e0 reads zOpt::GetGraphicsFlagsForCurrentHwMode, calls HudUiCheckToggleWidget::OnActivate, and then sets or clears zOpt_GraphicsFlags_GlobalLight in the saved flags according to self->checked.

Native smoke zhud_options_panel_lighting_sync_from_options_smoke installs software and hardware graphics flag option pointers, exercises set and clear transitions through OnActivate, and verifies only the current hardware-mode flag word is updated.
